notes: Deploy after the existing offer.queued backlog is drained so the new per-day accounting starts from a stable sent history. The schema change is additive and old customer versions publish the same event shape. During a rolling notifier deployment, old instances may still accept events without the cap; route new offer events only to new notifier instances once they are healthy, and roll back by stopping new instances and restarting the previous notifier version. Do not delete offer_daily or sent data.
